- Keep SCCs standard; Acme is EU-covered so we should propose the Modular/Updated SCCs where needed
- Retention limits: Acme wants 7 years for audit logs — confirm if that’s acceptable or needs scoped exception

Subject: Re: DPA redlines + procurement checklist

Olga / team — first-pass from Legal attached (RI_DPA_response_redlines_olga.docx). Summary of our position:

- SCCs & GDPR: We accept applying the EU SCCs; we'll provide the standard annex and data flow description. No EEA-only carve-outs beyond region-specific routing.
- Retention: We propose a compromise: 3 years for audit logs with the ability to extend to 5 years by written request; 7 years is excessive for system logs and raises storage and access obligations.
- Liability and Caps: We can accept a limited liability cap tied to fees for the first year; any change requires exec sign-off.
- Subprocessors & Audits: We'll provide a SOC 2 Type II report and completed CAIQ; for deeper audits we can provide a staffed SOC 2 evidence review session under NDA.
- Signature path: We prefer DocuSign. Operational checklist below.

Operational checklist (internal):
1) Legal final redline -> send to customer with tracked changes (deadline 12/04).
2) Confirm which exec will sign on Redwood side (Laura to confirm).
3) Generate DocuSign envelope and attach final DPA + PO instructions (if PO required).
4) Provide SOC2/CAIQ link + one-week window for evidence review.

Attachments: RI_DPA_response_redlines_olga.docx (docx, 32KB)

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — that approach makes sense. A couple of follow-ups from procurement:
- Can Redwood accept 5 years for audit artifacts as a middle ground? We can make 7 years optional by internal policy but prefer 5.
- PO: Acme prefers to issue a PO before countersignature — we can send the PO scan once the final DPA is in DocuSign. Please confirm the billing contact to include on the PO.

Attached is our procurement note on how we process POs (Acme_PO_instructions.pdf).

If we can get the final DPA in DocuSign by 12/08, procurement will target countersignature the same week.

Sara

Laura / Legal — final steps to close this deal:

1) Laura: please confirm you can be the Redwood exec signer for the DPA and approve the final redline (attached to DocuSign envelope). If you cannot, notify me today so we can route to the CTO.
2) Karthik: update the retention clause to 5 years per Acme's request and include the fallback escalation language for >5yr requests (exec approval).
3) Ops: once legal confirms, I will upload the final DPA to DocuSign and include the PO instructions. Sara, you can upload the PO scan into DocuSign when ready.

SOC2 & Evidence: per Karthik's note, here is the secure link to the SOC 2 Type II packet and the CAIQ (read-only): https://internal.redwood.com/soc2/2026/soc2-report-link (link requires redwood-acme NDA access; we will grant a 7-day evidence review window after envelope is sent).

Target timeline: Final redlines by EOD 12/08 -> DocuSign envelope sent 12/09 -> countersignature expected 12/10-12/14.

Olga
